    • item_definitions_match_bucket_state

      static void item_definitions_match_bucket_state(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.world.item.Item big, net.minecraft.world.item.Item mob)
      Manual: put empty, water-filled, lava-filled, and enchanted buckets next to one another in an inventory. Their appearances stay distinct, fluids and foil animate, and changing a slot's contents refreshes its icon. Put different items in two Junk Buckets and check both openings, then hold them in either hand and reload resources with F3+T; contents remain inside the rims. Automation: checks that every bucket has an item definition and that the component conditions selecting its models match the components each serialized bucket state carries.
